newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Indian GDRs down ahead of local holiday.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Indian GDRs down ahead of local holiday.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts lost ground on Wednesday amid limited interest ahead of a local Indian holiday on Thursday, traders said.
They said the market continued to bide its time as Indian stocks consolidated, and expected little change this week.
News that former finance minister P. Chidambaram would return to the government with the Tamil Maanila Congress party had given an early lift to Indian stocks, but profit taking soon cut into gains.
Traders said the market was keeping an eye on the 1997/8 budget which is now expected to go to a vote on May 9.
High GDR premiums to local stocks remained prohibitive, a trader said, and would most likely keep prices in a relatively tight band in the short term.
Reliance shed 18 cents to $19.50/$20.00 and State Bank of India dipped 25 cents to $24.10/$25.10. VSNL managed a 27 cent rise to $19.50/$20.00.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.31 points down at 79.88, with the premium over the local market at 19.21 percent from 20.69 percent.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index added 32.46.86 to 3,841.11.
A continued drop in Taipei stocks drove losses in the Capel Taiwan GDR Index, which shed 2.88 points to 125.50, representing a discount to the local market of 2.66 percent.
The Capel Korea GDR Index shed 2.16 points to 61.79 points, a premium of 26.07 percent over the local market.
